name: Dalian Naval Academy
zh: 中国人民解放军海军大连舰艇学院
aliases: Dalian Naval Academy of the PLA
Dalian Naval Ship Academy of the CPLA

evidence.summary: CASI describes Dalian Naval Academy, founded in 1949 as the Naval School and the PLA’s first academic institution, as a PLA Navy academy; its departments, last documented in 2007, covered navigation, shipborne weapons, communications and operational command, and it has two military key laboratories, for military navigation and marine surveying. Under the Central Military Commission’s 2025 admissions plan it also takes cadets for coast guard vessel-command and law-enforcement posts, giving them their general undergraduate education.
The academy reports to PLA Navy headquarters.

sources.title: The People’s Liberation Army’s 37 Academic Institutions (2020), pp. 121–123
